thread:
maya: Hey design/DevEx — quick design review request: new 'Invocation Logbook' for the Playground. Put together a prototype (link). Primary goals: make tool calls & structured output easier to inspect + allow schema diffs in run history. Need thoughts on layout, keyboard/accessibility, and copy. Screen: two-pane: left run history list, right detailed viewer with structured output + function definition inspector.
jordan: Nice. Can we keep run history compact by default? Most folks scan recent calls, don't need full payload inline. Maybe show verb + function name + time + status in list.
eli: Yes, compact by default. Also add a small chevron to expand inline output in the list for quick glance.
alex: Accessibility note: ensure the run list is a proper tree/list with aria-activedescendant navigation. Keyboard: up/down to traverse, Enter to open viewer, right arrow to expand inline. Also provide focus trap when viewer modal is open.
sam: Copy nit: 'Invocation Logbook' sounds internal. Consider 'Run History' or 'Execution Log' for user-facing. Also 'schema diff' wording might confuse product folks — maybe 'Schema changes' or 'Output shape change'.
maya: Good call on naming — I like 'Run History' as primary label, with 'Invocation details' as viewer header. Also we'll surface 'Schema Change' as a badge when output schema diverges from pinned schema.
jordan: UI question: where does function definition live? Inline on the right panel or a separate overlay? I vote inline compact card above the structured output so you can see the function signature + sample.
eli: Agree inline card. Add a small 'copy' button for the JSON schema and a link to 'Open in Schema Editor'.
maya: Prototype includes that. Here's the function def snippet we plan to render (JSON):
```
{
  "name": "summarize_articles",
  "description": "Condenses list of articles",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "articles": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}
    },
    "required": ["articles"]
  }
}
```
alex: UI accessibility: the JSON viewer should allow font-size zoom and respect high-contrast mode. Also provide an alternative 'table view' for arrays of objects.
sam: Also support copying example invocation cURL/snippet. When users click 'Copy example' we should produce a short snippet referencing model+function name.
jordan: About diffs — small inline diff view (unchanged/added/removed keys) is ideal. But keep it collapsed by default with a 'Show schema diff' toggle.
maya: Perf note: run history can get big. We'll paginate and lazy-load older entries. Need an affordance for 'pinning' important runs.
eli: Good. For long outputs, show truncated tree with 'Show full output' to avoid extreme reflows.
playground-bot: [deployed] Run History v0.3 pushed to staging. Playground tests: 312 passed, 2 a11y warnings.
maya: Lovely — can someone sketch the final copy for the viewer header and badges? I'll update the prototype after that.
sam: Draft:
- Header: 'Invocation details' (small subhead: 'Run History — Click a run to view details')
- Badge: 'Schema change' (red/orange) when divergence detected
- Buttons: 'Open in Schema Editor', 'Copy example', 'Export JSON'
alex: Also add an 'Accessibility' tooltip on keyboard shortcuts list: 'Press ? to view shortcuts'.
maya: Thanks all. @jordan @eli can you file one design task in Figma and one implementation ticket with a11y checklist? I'll close this thread once done. :raised_hands:
